introHtml:
Marketing directors looking for high-visibility trade show giveaways, HR directors assembling summer employee appreciation kits, and safety managers needing compliant eyewear for outdoor crews all turn to custom sunglasses. Whether you need a classic aviator for a company picnic, a sporty wrap for a 5K race, or a budget-friendly neon pair for a college orientation, this category covers every use case. From bamboo frames to recycled materials, the range of styles and price points means you can match your brand identity and budget without sacrificing quality.

Perfect Imprints stocks over 15 sunglass models, including the Nike® Chance Sunglasses for premium corporate gifts, the Rubberized Sunglasses for durable everyday wear, and the Retro Sunglasses for a nostalgic vibe. All styles accept your logo through screen printing, pad printing, or laser engraving. With bulk ordering starting at low minimums, you can outfit your entire team or event attendees while keeping per-unit costs down. Browse the grid below to compare features, then use the buying guide to make an informed decision.
buyingGuideHtml:
What to Look for in Custom Sunglasses

When ordering custom sunglasses, start with the frame material. Plastic frames are lightweight and cost-effective, while metal frames offer a premium feel. For eco-conscious branding, bamboo or recycled frames like the Cobra Recycled Sunglasses make a strong statement. Lens quality matters too: polycarbonate lenses provide impact resistance and UV protection, which is critical for safety programs or outdoor events. Always verify that the lenses block 99-100% of UVA/UVB rays to ensure your promotional sunglasses are both functional and safe.

Matching Sunglasses to Your Use Case

Corporate event planners often choose classic styles like the Aviator or Panama Sunglasses for a polished look at company picnics or golf outings. HR directors building employee wellness kits may prefer sporty wrap styles like the Sun Ray or Malibu Sunglasses for outdoor team-building days. Safety managers should look for models with shatterproof lenses and secure fit, such as the Rubberized Sunglasses. For trade shows and giveaways, budget-friendly neon or retro styles in bright colors attract attention and boost brand recall.

Decoration Options for Your Logo

Custom sunglasses accept your logo through several methods. Screen printing works well on flat temple arms and is economical for large quantities. Pad printing is ideal for curved surfaces or small logos on frames. Laser engraving offers a permanent, high-end finish on metal or bamboo frames, perfect for premium corporate gifts. Full-color heat transfer is available for designs with gradients or multiple colors. For the Nike® Chance Sunglasses, consider debossing or embroidery on the included case for an extra branding touch.

Quantity Guidance and Pricing

Bulk sunglass orders typically start at 50-100 units per style, with per-unit pricing dropping significantly at 250, 500, and 1,000 pieces. Wholesale pricing for promotional sunglasses is competitive, and ordering in larger quantities often allows for custom color matching on frames or lenses. For small events, low MOQs on select styles like the Sun Fun Sunglasses keep costs manageable. If you need samples, order a single unit first to test fit and decoration quality before committing to a full run.

Common Buying Mistakes to Avoid

One frequent mistake is overlooking lens tint. Dark lenses may look cool but can be unsafe for low-light indoor events. For safety programs, choose clear or lightly tinted lenses. Another pitfall is ignoring frame size: one-size-fits-most styles like the Promo Sunglasses work for general audiences, but for employee giveaways, consider offering two sizes. Finally, check lead times for decoration. Screen printing adds 5-10 business days, while engraving may take longer. Plan your order at least 3-4 weeks before your event to avoid rush fees.

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for custom sunglasses?
faqs.a: Minimum order quantities vary by style, but most models start at 50-100 units. Budget-friendly styles like the Sun Fun Sunglasses may have lower MOQs, while premium models like the Nike® Chance Sunglasses require higher minimums. Contact us for specific MOQs on your chosen style.

faqs.q: Can I get my logo printed on the lenses?
faqs.a: Logo printing on lenses is not recommended as it can obstruct vision and reduce UV protection. Most custom sunglasses are decorated on the temple arms or frame using screen printing, pad printing, or laser engraving. Some styles allow for small logos on the lens corner if space permits.

faqs.q: What decoration methods are available for sunglasses?
faqs.a: Common decoration methods include screen printing for flat temple arms, pad printing for curved surfaces, and laser engraving for metal or bamboo frames. Full-color heat transfer is available for complex designs. The best method depends on your frame material and logo complexity.

faqs.q: How long does production take for custom sunglasses?
faqs.a: Typical production time is 10-15 business days after artwork approval. Screen printing adds 5-10 days, while laser engraving may take longer. Rush orders are available for an additional fee. We recommend ordering at least 3-4 weeks before your event.

faqs.q: Do you offer samples before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, we offer sample orders for most sunglass styles. You can order a single unit to test fit, quality, and decoration placement. Sample pricing is higher than bulk pricing, but the cost is often credited back when you place a full order. Contact us for sample availability.
